title: OAuth flow status
description: Server-side status of one browser OAuth authorization started with presentation popup (1.1.0). The opener polls GET /v1/oauth/flows/{flow_id}; this document is the source of truth when Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy nulls window.opener. Only the principal that started the flow may read it (same application, tenant, workspace and principal); any other caller sees not_found. reason uses the fixed codes of internal/oauth (never free text from the provider). connection is set only when status is completed.

flow_id.description: Opaque id of the flow, minted by the core.

provider.description: The provider slug the flow was started for.

status.description: pending: waiting for the provider callback. completed: exchange succeeded. failed: refused or exchange failed. expired: the start window elapsed. cancelled: the opener deleted the flow (popup closed).

reason.description: Fixed machine-readable cause when status is failed, expired or cancelled. The values are the Reason codes of internal/oauth: manual_fallback, bad_request, bad_provider_config, unknown_provider, unknown_capability, consent_mismatch, redirect_rejected, state_unknown, state_expired, replayed, scope_mismatch, too_many_pending, access_denied, provider_error, issuer_mismatch, exchange_failed, bad_token_response, id_token_invalid, nonce_mismatch, account_mismatch, provider_unavailable, egress_denied, reauthorization_required, not_oauth, store_failed. Absent while pending or when completed without a side condition.

connection.description: The connection status after a successful exchange; absent otherwise.

updated_at.description: When this status was last written.

allOf.description: A completed flow carries the connection status.
A pending flow has no connection and no reason.
